about_the_game:
Good Things Vol 1 is a collection of fifteen brand new, wildly imaginative, weird little games lodged deep in the intestinal track of an elephant who didn't know better. From platformers to puzzles to explorations of meta and design, Good Things Vol 1 is all about chasing innovation through the intestinal track of a hungry little elephant.

Explore radical new games including:

PIZZA FOR ELEPHANTS

Create a pizza empire to feed a hungry hungry herd of thousands of elephants, melting hot idle and clicker game action with piping fresh 'za

FOUR SECOND FOREVER

Boop a snoot, dress a chinchilla with a cowboy hat, and assemble absolutely generic Nordic furniture all within 4 seconds or less in an endless parade of quickfire minigames

ONE HUNDRED RULES (TO LIVE BY)

Survive an ever-evolving gauntlet of new rules in an ever-changing world. Can you survive all 100?

DID WE SAY FIFTEEN GAMES?

A rhetorical question but boy howdy we sure did. Everything from action games like Stomp Your Friends to classic creature launching games like Flamippo, please use this handy flowchart to find a game you'll absolutely love:

Each game is appropriate for most audiences (no strong violence or swears!) using only keyboard and mouse.

For those who don't like charts, the games are: Flamippo, A Perfect Fit, Batteries Not Included, Pizza for Elephants, A Date Worth Waiting For, Four Second Forever, Coyote Time, One Hundred Rules (To Live By), Ball Revamped 6, Flipside, Ball Revamped: The Year, Don't Touch the Cake, Please Touch the Cake, Toggle, and Stomp Your Friends.

You begin in the gut of the elephant, a land called the Biome. All fifteen games live here tied together through a singular world map showing your progress and experiences. Track achievements and goals, all from one EXE! Why did the elephant eat the games? Why is the elephant in games he has eaten? Who was irresponsible enough to leave fifteen very wonderful games just sitting around? Is there a secret game about a pig!?

All of this and more to be explored in Good Things Vol 1!

From The Team Behind The Elephant Collection

Wonderful Elephant is born from John Cooney (jmtb02), last launching The Elephant Collection to Overwhelmingly Positive acclaim. Born in the Flash game era, working on over a hundred small games with over a billion plays, this newest collection highlights unbridled (neigh) explorations of play. Horses are not guaranteed in this title*

Content Warning

This series of games contains flashing/strobe lights that are not appropriate for those who are photosensitive. Please exercise caution in playing these games

*There are horses

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or higher
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Good Things Vol 1 is a collection of 15 wildly imaginative, weird little games ranging from evolving platformers to genre-bending adventure... but the Blue Elephant ate all the games, and if you do not help him he will DIE :(
